title: 第4章 仙童
content_zh:
“道爷。”

    韩榆提着心，站到了老道面前。

    老道一张丑不拉几的驴长脸，狐疑地看着他：“我没给你血食，又让你喂我的乌鸦，你这气血怎么还这么足？”

    韩榆闷不做声，看着老道。

    老道伸手搭在他脉门上，感应一下气血，顿时眉毛一跳。

    这小娃儿气血怎么跟壮汉一样旺盛？

    “小娃儿，你是怎么修炼的？给我看看！”

    韩榆听了之后，盘坐在地上，修炼了一次。

    老道仔细看着，也看不出来什么问题，不由地捏起自己山羊似的短须。

    炼血功可是自己好不容易从一个逃跑的魔道宗门血奴手里获得的假仙修炼之法，血滴子、养灵术、嗜血术三门法术更是超出武功范畴的“仙术”；没道理我这么经验丰富的人修炼需要日日补充血食，这小娃儿反而修炼之后气血充盈。

    这是怎么回事？

    是我练错了，还是这小娃儿练错了？

    老道捏着胡须，也得不出答案。

    毕竟他也没学过修仙，能按部就班修炼就已经是幸运，要说对功法有什么细节推测，当然是无处下手。

    “算了！”

    老道最后决定放弃，毕竟再有几日他就能踏进万春谷，进入修仙正途，炼血功这种连修仙功法都不是的假仙之法，也没什么值得关心的。

    “你修炼成这样，也不知道是好事还是坏事，随你去吧。”

    “若是你自己修炼出了问题一命呜呼，想必婉儿在天有灵也怨不得我。”

    说完之后，老道没再多说。

    韩榆心中松了一口气，回屋子喂养了大乌鸦，又自己逼出精血、复制精血来修炼，气血总量再次增加。

    第二日，老道又催动小毛驴往东而去，韩榆带着大乌鸦跟在后面。

    大乌鸦跟着他每天都能吃到充足血气，跟他明显亲近起来，一天之中盘旋在韩榆头顶的时间也因此变多，那种跃跃欲试把他当做血食的样子也消失不见。

    又过两日，路上行人变多，装饰华贵的轿子、骏马拉着的马车时不时出现，往往身后跟着侍女仆从护卫等等随从；还有舞刀弄枪，膀大腰圆的武林中人，或孤身一人，或三两成群，都朝着东方某一个方向而去。

    “道爷，他们也都去万春谷吗？”

    “对，他们也都去万春谷。”老道声音嘶哑，又略微得意地咧嘴一笑，“他们也都想要求仙长生，可是不管外面权势富贵，还是武功高强，到了这仙门之外都是一样的。”
content_en:
"Master Tao."

Han Yu stood in front of the old Taoist with his heart in mind.

The old Taoist had an ugly donkey-long face and looked at him suspiciously: "I didn't give you blood food, and I asked you to feed my crows. How come you still have so much energy and blood?"

Han Yu remained silent and looked at the old man.

The old Taoist stretched out his hand and placed it on his pulse gate, feeling the energy and blood, and his eyebrows jumped immediately.

How come this little kid has as much energy and blood as a strong man?

"Little baby, how do you practice? Show me!"

After hearing this, Han Yu sat cross-legged on the ground and practiced once.

The old Taoist looked carefully and couldn't see anything wrong, so he couldn't help but pinch his short goat-like beard.

The Blood Refining Technique is a fake immortal cultivation method that I finally obtained from a blood slave who escaped from the Demonic Sect. The three spells of Blood Drops, Spirit Nourishing Technique, and Blood Thirst Technique are "immortal arts" that go beyond the scope of martial arts. It makes no sense that an experienced person like me needs to replenish blood food every day to practice, but this little kid is full of energy and blood after practicing.

What's going on?

Did I practice wrongly, or did this little kid practice wrongly?

The old Taoist pinched his beard and couldn't come up with an answer.

After all, he has never learned how to cultivate immortality. He is lucky enough to be able to practice step by step. If he wants to speculate on the details of the technique, of course he has nowhere to start.

"Forget it!"

The old Taoist finally decided to give up. After all, in a few days he would be able to step into the Ten Thousand Spring Valley and enter the true path of cultivating immortals. The blood refining technique, a fake immortal method that was not even a method of cultivating immortals, was nothing worth caring about.

"I don't know if it's a good thing or a bad thing that you've cultivated like this. Just let it go."

"If something goes wrong with your own cultivation and you die, I'm sure Wan'er has a soul in heaven and can't blame me."

After finishing speaking, the old Taoist said no more.

Han Yu breathed a sigh of relief and went back to the house to feed the crow. He also forced out and copied the blood essence for cultivation, and the total amount of qi and blood increased again.

The next day, the old Taoist urged the little donkey to go east again, and Han Yu followed with the big crow.

The big crow ate enough blood every day with him, and became obviously close to him. As a result, it spent more time hovering over Han Yu's head during the day, and its eagerness to treat him as blood food disappeared.

After another two days, there were more pedestrians on the road. From time to time, luxuriously decorated sedan chairs and horse-drawn carriages appeared, often followed by maids, servants, guards, and other entourages. There were also people from the martial arts world who were wielding swords and guns, and were big and round, either alone or in groups of three or two, all heading towards a certain direction in the east.

"Master Tao, are they all going to Wanchun Valley too?"

"Yes, they all go to Wanchun Valley." The old Taoist's voice was hoarse, and he grinned slightly proudly. "They also want to ask for immortality, but no matter whether they are powerful, wealthy or powerful outside, they are the same outside this immortal sect."
